reviewItem.question: For "Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether any Kafka cluster is still ZooKeeper-based rather than KRaft; the evidence names no field or setting that shows it

proposed.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration, so all clusters must already be on KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.
